method: Captured the real export request the website issues, then replayed it from the page context (so auth headers and cookies are the browser's own) with one field altered per case.

results.note: The unmodified replay succeeds, so a 409 below is caused by the alteration, not by the replay itself.

results.alteration: Inserted '**Northrop Grumman** -- Falls Church, VA' into final_written_section_markdown.
Set headline to 'Chief Technology Officer' in the structured payload.
Replaced the last 4 characters of the signed receipt with 'AAAA'.

verdict: 4/4 tamper cases refused, each with a distinct reason; the unmodified control is accepted.
